notes: v1.26: Startup crash now visible, not silent under pythonw. Import failures and database initialisation failures used to happen before the old crash handler, so the app just closed with no log and no dialog. Now a startup-failure helper (defined before any risky import) writes a fresh timestamped crash_log.txt first, then shows a clear error dialog (tkinter, else Windows MessageBox, else stderr), then exits — without creating a new database, without switching paths, and without deleting/replacing/moving any existing database or Excel file. If the error is 'unable to open database file', check that this Windows user can write to the Database folder shown in the dialog/log. write_crash_log no longer fails when the database did not initialise. The old Treeview.insert() 'missing index' error is already fixed (v1.9) and was not repeated; dashboard refresh was already guarded per tab (v1.8). Includes v1.25 (weight numbers only, scrollable Dashboard + shortcuts help), v1.24 (Space always jumps to table, not Enter), v1.23 (Bill No. renamed to Bill No./Rokar/Book everywhere), v1.22 (Sold column green only when sold, not when Opening = Returned), v1.21 (simpler live rates banner, no buttons, gold/silver only), v1.20 (live MCX banner from mcxlive.org, gold per 10 g, silver per 1 kg), v1.19 (B/Space shortcuts, sale -> Amount, 4-decimal weights, Attendance tab), v1.18 (Box Out horizontal scrolling), v1.17 (Return->Sell notification), v1.16 (return first then sell), v1.15 (version always visible), v1.14 (gold cell, autocomplete), v1.13 (gold row/field/header), v1.12 (horizontal sale row), v1.11 (keyboard Sell panel, Added column, Reset), v1.10 (manual cell entry), v1.9 (table fix), v1.8 (crash-proof startup), v1.7 (empty Return), v1.6 (keyboard-first), v1.5 (GOLD/SILVER), v1.4 (client installer), v1.3 (sale Mode/Amount/Bill No.), v1.2 (no cmd window), v1.1 (Ramanand Jewellers, gold icon).
